results.title: Agent Systems and GIS Integration in Requirements ...
results.content: The conducted study confirms that the integration of agent-based systems with GIS tools and large-scale data processing platforms such as Apache Spark and PostGIS provides effective support for the site selection of agricultural biogas plants. As a result, the proposed solution not only automates the selection process but also enhances its transparency and usability for designers and decision-makers, eliminating the need for time-consuming manual work in classical GISs. In this way, agent-based systems combined with GISs are thus becoming fully functional instruments of environmental management, supporting both spatial planning and sustainable development policies [100,101].
